_comment: Canonical JLCPCB order settings for the froemix base board. tscircuit has no prop for surface finish or assembly side, so these live here and are copied into fab/ by `bun run release` / `make release`. Upload the artifacts listed in doc/JLC-ASSEMBLY.md and set these options on the order page.

board.surface_finish_reason: flat pads for the 40 through-hole Daisy Seed pads and the 2.00mm headers; tin/HASL leaves uneven mounds that make the module sit off-square

assembly.sides_reason: 97 of 110 placements are on the bottom (all analog/audio/CV/MIDI circuitry); only the mating headers, rail SMD and PMOD live on top. Two-sided means two stencil/paste passes - enable 'assembly for both sides'.
assembly.through_hole_note: kept in the BOM but excluded from the CPL; add them back on the order page only if you pay for JLCPCB THT assembly
assembly.do_not_place_note: Daisy Seed module is already owned; it is absent from BOM and CPL by design
assembly.fiducials: 4 x 1mm bare copper with 0.5mm mask window at (+-33, +-63)mm - verify bright in the placement preview

inspect_before_paying: 4 layers, 80.9 x 128.5 mm, four 3.2mm M3 holes
bottom-side rotations sane in the 3D preview (all 0 or 180 deg, H1 270)
Daisy Seed footprint empty (module is hand-fitted)
GND plane visible on the bottom layer preview
